r.name: National Cycle Route 2 South Mundham to Christchurch
A Walk to the Huff Duff, SW Hants
r.description: Descend to the wooded valley at Dockens Water & cross the stream to Rockford Common. See carnivourous sundews & mosses in wet heath & bog. Enjoy views at Ibsley Common (an area full of military history) & visit the Huff Duff (an old directional station).

r.name: Kingston Lacy walk at Holt Heath, Kingston Lacy
